description.en:
Opens the message window with a text, as a child scene of the event. The ev_main helpers CreateSpeech, CreateSpeechHide, CreateSpeech_MatchStart, CreateMessage, CreateMonologue and CreateMakikaeshi wrap it: they call it, then suspend() until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE() is false, that is until the player has closed the message.
The arguments are stored as settings of the window (their names come from the engine): TextID, CenterX, CenterY, Window, then the speaker (WashaID, from the character given), DrawRightWasha, DrawScr and OnTeamLv.
CenterX setting: centre the text horizontally (true for monologues).
CenterY setting: centre the text vertically (true for monologues).
Window setting: show the speech window (true for dialogue, false for monologues).
Speaking character (parameter ID or hash); its name ID is stored as WashaID. 0 for none.
DrawRightWasha setting: show the speaker on the right side.
DrawScr setting: screen to draw on (e.g. SCREEN_A).

Always true once the window is requested.
null if the script system is not ready or too few arguments are given.
